patch_description: This redesign replaces the long single-chain annealer with a batched multi-chain search architecture. All free points are represented in barycentric coordinates inside a fixed triangular convex hull, guaranteeing feasibility. Several deterministic search chains explore simultaneously, evaluating candidate perturbations in vectorized batches with an annealed lower-tail objective before a dedicated maximin polishing stage. This reduces Python-loop overhead, improves basin coverage, preserves the best exact solution independently from surrogate decisions, and keeps output deterministic.
